searchText: Would there be any value in having 3 steps as part of the merge process instead of two. Would there be any value in having 3 steps as part of the merge process instead of two.

For example instead of going from Decentralized Mining -> Proof of Stake

Why not do Decentralized mining -> trusted miner -> The merge

This would eliminate some of the concerns about the merge? Has that idea been considered? 🤔
